label: Early steps (t=3-5) of sequences starting with 3/c after recent s/t/w/2/u inputs
explanation: Sparse feature active only at steps 3-5 (about 99% of mass), in the original phase or at the <DEL> step when L is 3-5; it essentially never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. It is strongly enriched for sequences whose first token is 3 (13.6x lift) or c (9.2x), together accounting for about 77% of mass, and for the previous two inputs being from {2,t,w,s,u} / {s,t,2,c,w} (prev_tok=2 has 12.7x lift). The top activations look like prefixes such as "3 s t 2 <DEL>", "c c s 2 <DEL>", "3 c w t <DEL>". It looks like a conjunction of prefix tokens in hidden state rather than a clean rule: requiring first token in {3,c} plus the two recent-token sets reaches only about 0.38 precision and 0.28 recall on dev, and the looser versions (first token 3/c and t in 3..5) cover 75% of mass at 3% precision. Magnitude is higher when the predicate holds (top-quartile coverage is higher for each predicate), but no rule cleanly determines it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=3 (+6.19), prev_tok=2 (+5.76), orig0=c (+4.62), t=3 (+4.53), phase=2 & out_tok=3 (+4.29), t=4 (+4.18). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.38), in_tok=s (-3.32), orig2=h (-3.01), orig2=m (-2.82).
